reviews.title: Looks good, plays well
reviews.comment: I got this little thing to upgrade my PC between water cooling loops.  I have no regrets it looks good and upgraded my functionality for OCing.
reviews.author: Phillip Bramley

reviews.title: Mal
reviews.comment: El producto salió malo, no da imagen y el botón de flash BIOS estaba malo
reviews.author: Brayan Estiven Gomez Ruiz

reviews.title: Perfect working order
reviews.comment: Motherboard came in perfect working order,  2/4 M.2 screws were OEM minor cosmetic scratches on top right of board that are hardly noticeable. all and all a nice deal!
reviews.author: austin

reviews.title: Muy buen precio dada la calidad y la gama del producto
reviews.comment: Muy buen producto, cumple con todas las características mencionadas, pequeño detalle en flash bios button por lo demás excelente producto
reviews.author: John henry
